prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, a single transparent game character source, candidate 101 / D66-BODY02, the Guardian companion drone for Project RL.
Reference image 1 is the old tiny Guardian: keep its basic role and recognizable stout biped machine identity, broad orange torso and heavy arms, but completely redraw it with proper readable shapes and serious quality. Reference image 2 is STYLE ONLY: match this Artilleur's crisp black ink contours, dimensional hard-edged cel shading, worn industrial metal, simple strong masses and restrained serious graphic-novel finish. Do not copy its tank shape or its guns.
Create one full-body compact protective combat robot, strictly frontal, symmetric stance, two short sturdy mechanical legs planted apart and two large powerful armored forearms with clearly attached clenched mechanical fists. The slightly recessed small sensor head is integrated into a broad armored chest, not a human helmet. Broad protective forearms and reinforced shoulder/chest plates communicate a close-combat bodyguard. Keep the anatomy mechanically coherent and solid; distinct visible elbows, waist and knees, clear negative spaces separating arms and torso. Stocky but not a giant human soldier. Palette: dark graphite joints and frame, substantial muted burnt-industrial-orange armor panels on chest and shoulders, light brushed steel edges/forearms for readability. No pink, purple, cyan or blue glowing circuits.
Design for a roughly 56-pixel tall actor inside a native64 game tile: bold legible silhouette, few large plates, clear fists and feet; no microscopic texture or complicated cables. Draw the source at high resolution, actual RGBA transparency, full body entirely contained with a clean margin. No background, floor, shadow, text, border, logos, aura, shield effect, handheld shield, guns, barrels, missile launchers or extra weapons. The Guardian attacks by striking in melee; its protection effect is rendered separately. One single character only, not a character sheet.
